name: Shite Mizuho
source:
A female student who was a  patient of Sakaguchi's at Jomiya General Hospital. She loves sex. She is a flamboyant girl who likes to stand on her own to feet. 

She is interested in Sakaguchi and even when she has no reason to go the hospital she goes just to see him.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=611]Getchu[/url]]
